## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic completed its scheduled activity during February 2025. A total of 364 photographic captures were recorded. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, and there were no reported operational issues affecting the delivery of the service. Activity levels provide the basis for the image-quality and grading measures set out below.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 18 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.9 per cent. The result should be monitored through routine review of image capture practice and session performance. Continued attention to image acquisition may help maintain consistency and support the timely grading of submitted images.

## Grading

Grading identified 92 referable results during the reporting period. The median lag from photograph to grade was 2 days. This indicates that grading activity was completed within the expected operational workflow, while the referable findings require the usual follow-up processes. The site should continue to review activity, image quality and grading performance as part of routine service monitoring.
